name: Teleflex Incorporated
summary: Teleflex Incorporated designs, develops, manufactures, and supplies single-use medical devices for common diagnostic and therapeutic procedures in critical care and surgical applications in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and internationally.
